item.title: Music on the Porch Day — Sat Aug 29, 10:00 AM — the Atelier
item.description:
Join the Sacramento Community Music Circle at The Atelier for a global movement celebrated every last Saturday in August. Whether playing along or listening, all ages and abilities are welcome to join the jam! Is there a fee? This show is free and open to the public. What is the Atelier? Located in Midtown Sacramento, The Atelier is a contemporary studio and gallery dedicated to empowering creators of all ages.
Source: The Dirt

item.title: 21st National Juried Exhibition — Sat Aug 29, 12:00 PM — Axis Gallery
item.description: AXIS GALLERY 21st ANNUAL NATIONAL JURIED COMPETITION August 7–30, 2026 Second Saturday Reception August 8, 2026, 5–8 PM Axis Gallery presents the 21st Annual National Juried Competition, a group exhibition featuring works selected by juror Sharon Butler, founder of Two Coats of Paint. The exhibition includes works by artists from around the country in a variety of mediums. JUROR’S STATEMENT The Axis Gallery received 658 submissions to an open call, and I could have selected five exhibitions instead of one without feeling professionally compromised. Narrowing such a high- quality profusion down to a single hang was a real challenge. Whereas traditional thematic trawls tend to be self-limiting, open calls like this one afford the juror no circumscribing guidance – only that of quality on the terms artists set for themselves. And the work I perused made it clear that artists throughout the country and across genres are richly engaged in conversations about ideas, materials, emotional c

item.title: After5 Live — Sat Aug 29, 7:30 PM — The Melon Ball – Watermelon Music
item.description:
After5 is a Sacramento-based modern jazz group blending R&B, Neo Soul, and fusion into their sound. The band plays a mix of original music and their own arrangements of both modern hits and classic tunes, giving each song a fresh feel while keeping the groove front and center. It’s a sound built for listeners who love jazz and for anyone just looking for good music to vibe to. $15 General Admission $10 Seniors (in-store or at the door only) $10 Students (in-store or at the door only, w/ID) Doors open @ 7:00pm This is a BYOB event!
Source: The Dirt

item.title: Weekly Game Night at Blue Note — Wed Sep 16, 5:00 PM
item.description:
Yolo County Board Game Gathering Update 8/14/25: **We're still active**, but we primarily use Discord to chat and plan events. (See group description for invite link.)
We still meet every Wednesday for board games at Blue Note Brewing Company. We'll have a handful of tables reserved near the back; just look for the pile of board games.
People usually start arriving around 5pm, and games start whenever people are ready. Blue Note closes at 9pm, and although we have a 5-10 minute grace period there, you should be in the process of final scoring by 9, or else pack it up and play again another day.
Game night is open to all ages! Blue Note is a brewery, not a bar, so there's no restriction against minors. In addition to their crafted-in-house beer selection, water and sodas are available.
You're not required to buy anything in order to join us, but we do encourage you to support local businesses. Blue Note's chef team makes a mean pizza, and there are other nearby downtown restaurants

item.title: Davis Farmers Market — Sat Aug 29, 8:00 AM — Central Park
item.description:
Year-round at Central Park in downtown Davis, thousands gather each week to shop for what is grown, raised, and made locally at our markets. We are dedicated to bringing farmers right to your table, so we stay open rain or shine. Walk rows of stalls lined with an array of fruits and vegetables, including certified organic produce, choice meats, chicken, seafood, wine, local eggs and honey. Choose from a variety of fresh-baked goods, plants, flowers and gifts. Enjoy a picnic from one of our many food stands, made from market ingredients. See the vendor list here: https://www.davisfarmersmarket.org/our-sellers/ Farmers Market Hours Central Park: Saturdays 8a–1p (year-round), and Wednesdays 3p–6p (September through March); 4p–8p (April through August) UC Davis – North Quad: Wednesdays 10a–1:30p (fall and spring quarters) Sutter Davis Hospital: Thursdays 10a–1p (May through September) Sutter Medical Center, Sacramento: Thursdays 2:30p–5:30p
Source: The Dirt

Join the Davis Visibility Brigade each Thursday and Sunday to make VISIBLE our opposition to the endless corruption, incompetence, and immorality of the current regime. item.title: Conscious Conversations & Somatic Practices — Mon Sep 21, 6:00 PM
item.description:
Iama Embodied Community This is a spiritual community that honors the body’s wisdom and lived experience. Whether you’re healing from religious trauma, deconstructing beliefs, exploring spirituality, or just want to be with other conscious persons, this space is for you.
Expect conscious conversations, meditation, breathwork, sound healing, and other somatic practices to help reconnect with ourselves and each other.
we share a potluck dinner every last Monday of the month.
📅 **Date & Time**: Mondays 6-8 PM 📍 **Location**: 727 T St. Sacramento, Ca, 95811 💜 **All our events are free, donations supported.** ✨ **No prior experience or spiritual beliefs necessary.** 📩 **RSVP/ Questions? Reach out at** embody.iama@gmail.com 🔗 **Follow us on Instagram:** [@embody.iama](https://www.instagram.com/embody.iama)
PS: we meet in the social hall of Parkview Presbyterian Church. Please find us through the back entrance, the brown gate on Solons alley. You may park in the back, move the orange post

item.title: Gentle yoga — Tue Sep 22, 10:00 AM
item.description:
Iama Embodied Community This is a slow and mindful practice that emphasizes deep breathing, body awareness, and nervous system regulation. This class is accessible to all abilities, providing a supportive and trauma-informed space to reconnect with the body.
Sessions alternate between floor yoga and chair yoga (on the 2nd and 4th Tuesday). Stay a bit longer on the last Tuesday of the month and join us for coffee or tea afterward!
Like all our events, this class is free, donations are welcome.
Source: Meetup: Mindful Embodied Spirituality

item.description:

Participants may bring their own deck, but we recommend you leave your most precious cards at home.
